log: Act VI, R3: from the frozen end of Act V (the morning, R1) through the gap (R2) into the garden: the gardener's gift, the basin, the people who say what they always said
the end of Act V: the house
the walk to the gap is R1 and R2 (akt6_leere, akt6_spalt): here the light is simply there
out into the valley, to the place where she arrived in the rain
the gap of light: she stands in it
she touches it: the look, five lines, and then the question
the five lines of the look, one click each (a wait would click through the question too)
the question stands on Stay: she moves to Going through
a step, the light, the black, and Elysia
the corner builds itself up, the garden as she left it

the welcoming ones: they offer before she asks
an Elysian on the way: the same sentences, the same walk
